hypothesis: Speech-like detections differ between predefined test and control windows.
null_hypothesis: Detection rate does not differ between windows.
control_condition: Matched unattended quiet windows without questions.
analysis_plan: Count predefined events using same rules in both windows.
blinding_plan: Reviewers receive randomized, anonymized audio clips without condition labels.
consent_plan: Only consenting operators participate; no recordings of private bystanders.
uncertainty_plan: Report device noise, clock error and false positives separately.
human_review_plan: Two people independently assess any candidate; disagreement retained.
clock_sync_plan: Compare independent audio and camera clocks before and after each run.
